title: Chunka Hukniyuq Quyllurkuna K’umuykukuq
intro: Quranmanta huk siqimanmi wawa kayninpi ukhu rikuyta qurqanku — hanaq pacha kurkukuna yupaychaywan k'umuykusqankumanta musquy. Watakuna pasanman karqan traicionasqa, t’aqanakuy, llulla tumpasqa, carcelpi wisq’asqa kay manaraq kay rikuy hunt’akushaqtin. ¿Pitaq kay mana kuyuriq alma, paypa willakuyninmi Quranpa aswan hatun capitulonta hapin?
clues: Huk kutinmi waynallaraq karqani, admirakunapaq hina mosqoywanmi saminchasqa karqani, chaytaqa kikin taytaypas advertiwarqanmi sapallaypi kanaypaq.
Kikin wawqeykuna, envidiawan ñawsayachisqa, contraypi yuyaykurqanku, hinaspan ukhu tutayaq pukyuman wikch’uwarqanku.
Karu hallp’aman apawarqanku, hinaspan huk allin qhawarisqa oficialpa wasinman vendewarqanku, chaypin allin qhawarisqa karqani, hinaspan responsabilidadpi wicharirqani.
Yanqa tumpakuymi mana chanin carcelman wisq’asqa kanaypaq apawarqan, chaywanpas chay tutayaq cheqaspin sonqochayta tarirqani Allahman mañakuypi, k’umuykukuspa ima.
Allah saminchawarqan mosqoykunata t’ikrayta mana ancha rikusqa atiywan, chaymi qhepaman chay hallp’a kamachikuqpa ñawpaqenman apawarqan, hinaspan hatun posición de confianzaman hoqariwarqan.
Unay watakuna t’aqanakusqaymanta, munasqa aylluywan hukllawakurqani, warma kasqaypi chunka hukniyuq quyllurkuna, inti, killa ima k’umuykuwasqanmanta musqukusqaymi tukupaypi hunt’akurqa.

arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِى ٱشْتَرَىٰهُ مِن مِّصْرَ لِٱمْرَأَتِهِۦٓ أَكْرِمِى مَثْوَىٰهُ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَنفَعَنَآ أَوْ نَتَّخِذَهُۥ وَلَدًۭا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ مَكَّنَّا لِيُوسُفَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلِنُعَلِّمَهُۥ مِن تَأْوِيلِ ٱلْأَحَادِيثِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَالِبٌ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرِهِۦ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verse: And the one from Egypt who bought him said to his wife, "Make his residence comfortable. Perhaps he will benefit us, or we will adopt him as a son." And thus, We established Joseph in the land that We might teach him the interpretation of events [i.e., dreams]. And Allāh is predominant over His affair, but most of the people do not know. (12:21)
